title: In JetBrains TeamCity before 2026.1.3 privilege escalation was possible by issuing new tokens from a restricted access…
description: A privilege escalation vulnerability exists in JetBrains TeamCity versions before 2026.1.3. The flaw allows an attacker with restricted access tokens to issue new tokens with elevated privileges. The vulnerability has a low CVSS score of 3.1 and does not impact confidentiality or availability but can lead to limited integrity issues.
